findings.location: task.errors[e1].outcomes["ser.profession/construction-use"]: "incorrect"; task.errors[e1].feedbackUk: "У простому повідомленні про професію артикль після ser не ставимо: Mi padre es médico."
findings.description: Omitting the article is the usual neutral pattern, but an indefinite article with a profession noun is not categorically incorrect and does not necessarily express an evaluation. The feedback turns the preferred teaching pattern into an absolute prohibition.
findings.suggestion: Move “Mi padre es un médico y es de Odesa.” into accepted. Retain the article-free model and explain that the article is usually omitted when simply stating a profession.

items.reviewerAnswer: Mi padre es médico y es de Odesa. The variant “Mi padre es un médico y es de Odesa” is also grammatically acceptable.
items.notes: The absence of other acceptable phrasings is not itself a closed-key defect: closed is not true, and the feedback explicitly leaves unlisted answers ungraded.
